description:
List the workspace's monitors with their live status and uptime.

Filters are applied in this order: tag (server side), then status and search (name/URL substring), then offset/limit. At most 5000 monitors are scanned ("scan_capped": true when there were more); narrow with tag.
Returns {total, count, offset, has_more, next_offset?, items: Monitor[]} where each Monitor has id, name, type, url, interval_seconds, is_active, current_status (up/down/degraded/paused/pending/maintenance), uptime_24h, uptime_30d, last_checked_at, last_error, open_incident, tags, external_id.

Use sutramx_get_monitor for one monitor's full details and sutramx_get_check_results for its check history.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (readable summary) or 'json' (full structured data)

search.description: Case-insensitive substring of name or URL

status.description: Only monitors currently in this status

name: sutramx_list_monitors
title: List monitors
